name: Host Domination Booking Engine: Calendar Sync & Reservation System
author: Host Domination

sections.installation:
1. Download, install and activate Host Domination Booking Engine from your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Open the Host Domination Booking Engine menu and create your first booking calendar.
  3. Enter the calendar or accommodation name, maximum number of guests and minimum number of nights.
  4. Optionally, set the base price per night, choose EUR or USD and enable the option to display the price in the public calendar.
  5. To import unavailable dates, paste the iCal or ICS URL provided by Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo or another compatible OTA into the External iCal Link field.
  6. Save the calendar. If a valid external iCal URL was entered, the plugin performs the initial import immediately.
  7. In the Created Properties / Rooms table, copy the shortcode generated for your calendar. It will use this format:

[hdbe_booking_calendar id=”123″]

  1. Replace 123 only when writing the shortcode manually. The safest option is to copy the exact shortcode generated by the plugin.
  2. Create or edit the WordPress page where you want to display the booking engine and paste the generated shortcode.
  3. Publish or update the page, then verify the calendar, minimum-stay rule, availability and booking request form from the front end.
  4. To export confirmed website reservations, copy the Website iCal Feed URL generated by the plugin and import it into the compatible external booking platform.
  5. The Free plugin checks connected external calendars approximately every 30 minutes. Use the Refresh Calendars button whenever you want to run an immediate manual import.

Using the shortcode with Gutenberg

Create or edit a WordPress page, add a Shortcode block and paste the exact shortcode generated in the Created Properties / Rooms table.

Example:

[hdbe_booking_calendar id=”123″]

Publish or update the page and verify the booking engine from the front end.

Using the shortcode with Elementor

Create or edit a page with Elementor, add the Shortcode widget and paste the exact shortcode generated by Host Domination Booking Engine.

Example:

[hdbe_booking_calendar id=”123″]

Publish or update the page and verify the booking calendar and reservation request form from the front end.

Displaying multiple calendars

When multiple accommodation calendars have been created, you can display all active calendars with a property selector by using:

[hdbe_booking_calendars]

Use the individual generated shortcode when you want to display only one specific accommodation calendar.

Calendar synchronization

To configure two-way iCal calendar synchronization:

  1. Copy the external iCal or ICS URL from Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo or another compatible OTA or booking platform.
  2. Paste the URL into the External iCal Link field in Host Domination Booking Engine.
  3. Save the calendar. The first import is performed immediately.
  4. Copy the Website iCal Feed URL generated by the plugin.
  5. Import the generated URL into the external booking platform.
  6. Confirm website booking requests before expecting them to appear in the exported iCal feed.
  7. The Free plugin automatically checks the connected external feeds approximately every 30 minutes.
  8. Select Refresh Calendars whenever you want to run an immediate manual import.

The 30-minute interval is approximate because WordPress scheduled tasks are normally triggered by website traffic and can be affected by the hosting environment or server configuration.

The external OTA controls how frequently it publishes, reads and updates imported calendars. Some booking platforms refresh iCal feeds automatically at their own intervals, while others may offer or require a manual refresh.

New reservations, cancellations, blocked dates or availability changes may therefore not appear immediately on every connected platform.

Always check the calendar synchronization settings and refresh policy provided by each connected OTA.
sections.faq:
Is Host Domination Booking Engine a complete WordPress reservation system?

It provides a direct booking request form, availability calendar, request management, external iCal import and a website iCal export feed.

It is not a complete OTA channel manager/PMS and does not synchronize listing content, messages, reviews or platform pricing through private APIs.

Is the plugin open source and self-hosted?

Yes. Host Domination Booking Engine is licensed under GPLv2 or later and runs directly inside your WordPress website.

The Free version does not require a mandatory Host Domination cloud account or subscription and does not expire.

What is the correct shortcode?

Each calendar generates a shortcode in this format:

[hdbe_booking_calendar id=”123″]

Copy the exact shortcode from the Created Properties / Rooms table because the ID is different for each calendar.

Platform/OTA compatibility list

Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo, Agoda, Expedia, Tripadvisor, Stripe, Google and Apple are trademarks of their respective owners.
Host Domination Booking Engine is an independent WordPress plugin and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by these companies.
Compatibility depends on the availability and format of the iCal or ICS feed supplied by each external service.

Can I display multiple accommodation calendars?

The Free version and PRO support unlimited accommodation calendars. To display all active calendars with a selector, use:

[hdbe_booking_calendars]

Can I synchronize the calendar with Airbnb?

Yes. Copy the compatible Airbnb iCal export URL into the External iCal Link field. You can also import the Website iCal Feed URL generated by the plugin into Airbnb.

Can I synchronize the calendar with Booking.com?

Yes, when the property account provides compatible iCal import and export functions.

Does the plugin work with Vrbo?

Yes, when a compatible Vrbo iCal or ICS URL is available.

Does it work with Agoda or Expedia?

The plugin can process standard iCal and ICS URLs. Compatibility depends on whether the platform, property account, connectivity provider or connected property management system provides a compatible calendar feed.

Is this a direct API integration with booking platforms?

No. The plugin uses standard iCal and ICS calendar feeds and does not connect through the private APIs of Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo, Agoda or Expedia.

Is Host Domination Booking Engine a channel manager/PMS?

No. It is a WordPress booking engine and reservation request system with iCal availability synchronization.

Does calendar synchronization happen automatically?

Yes. The website iCal export feed updates immediately when a booking is confirmed. When a valid external iCal URL is saved, the plugin attempts the initial import immediately and then checks connected feeds automatically approximately every 30 minutes.

The interval is approximate because WordPress cron execution normally depends on website traffic, hosting conditions and server configuration.

You can also click Refresh Calendars at any time to run an immediate manual import.

External OTAs independently determine when they synchronize their calendars and read the Website iCal Feed URL. Their synchronization schedules are outside the plugin’s control.

Does synchronization happen in real time?

The website iCal export feed is updated immediately, but connected OTAs import it according to their own schedules. Incoming iCal feeds are checked approximately every 30 minutes, subject to WordPress cron and hosting conditions. This is not a real-time OTA integration.

Can iCal synchronization prevent double bookings?

It can reduce the risk by importing unavailable dates and exporting confirmed website reservations. It cannot guarantee instant synchronization or completely eliminate overlapping reservations.

Can I combine multiple iCal calendars into one link?

Yes, with Host Domination Booking Engine PRO.

Multiple feeds connected to the same accommodation calendar are imported and consolidated into one Website iCal Feed URL containing the combined confirmed and unavailable periods.

Can I use the unified iCal link in another system?

Yes, provided that the destination OTA, calendar application, property management system or reservation tool supports standard iCal or ICS imports.

Does a pending website request block the dates?

No. A new website request remains pending until an administrator confirms it. Confirmed requests are included in the unavailable dates and in the website iCal export feed. When offline bank transfer is enabled for a property, an approved request remains in Awaiting Payment without blocking the dates until the administrator marks the received transfer as paid.

Can I set a minimum number of nights?

Yes. The minimum stay can be configured for the calendar and is validated in both the front-end form and the server-side booking request process.

Can I display a nightly price in the Free version?

Yes. You can configure an optional base price per night and display it on available dates in the front-end calendar.

Can I set different prices for individual dates?

Advanced day, month and yearly pricing features are available with Host Domination Booking Engine PRO.

Can I block specific dates or complete months?

Advanced date and month blocking is available with Host Domination Booking Engine PRO.

Can guests pay online?

Stripe online payments are available with Host Domination Booking Engine PRO.

Does Stripe charge transaction fees?

Stripe may apply its own processing fees and service terms. These are independent of Host Domination Booking Engine.

Can I use the plugin with Elementor?

Yes. Add an Elementor Shortcode widget and paste the exact shortcode generated for the calendar.

Is Host Domination Booking Engine lightweight and optimized for speed?

Yes. The plugin uses selective loading for calendar-specific assets so they are not requested unnecessarily on pages without booking calendars. Version 1.4.97 extends this optimization to Flatpickr JavaScript, its Italian locale and the global calendar selector, while retaining shortcode, Gutenberg and Elementor support. Overall website performance also depends on the theme, hosting and other installed plugins.

Can I use the plugin with Gutenberg?

Yes. Add a WordPress Shortcode block and paste the exact shortcode generated for the calendar.

Does the Free version expire?

No. The Free version is not a time-limited trial.

Does the booking form require privacy consent?

Yes. The website administrator must configure a valid Privacy Policy URL in Calendar Settings. Guests must confirm that they have read and accept the linked Privacy Policy before a FREE or PRO booking request can be submitted.

The administrator can also enter an optional Terms and Conditions URL. When it is configured, the same required consent confirms acceptance of both the linked Privacy Policy and the linked Terms and Conditions.

Personal data is stored in the website database. The website owner is responsible for providing an appropriate Privacy Policy and complying with applicable privacy and data-protection requirements, including the GDPR where applicable.

Can booking requests also be received through WhatsApp?

Yes. In Calendar Settings, Email is always enabled and mandatory. You can optionally enable WhatsApp for the selected calendar and enter the destination number in international format, including the country code.

When the guest submits a valid request, the plugin first saves the request in WordPress and sends the normal notification email. It then opens WhatsApp with the property, dates, guest counts and contact details already filled in. The guest must review the message and tap Send. This workflow uses a standard WhatsApp link and does not require the WhatsApp Business API.

sections.description:
Free Booking Engine for Hotels, B&Bs, Vacation Rentals: Direct Bookings, Payments, Auto iCal Sync (Airbnb, Booking & More), Free Chatbot AI Add-on.

Free WordPress Booking Engine for Short Term Rental / Vacation Rentals, B&Bs & Hotels

Fast & Lightweight WordPress Booking Engine for Unlimited Properties & Rooms – A streamlined, performance-focused booking tool for hosts who want a fast, efficient reservation experience without unnecessary assets on pages that do not display a booking calendar.

Demo Free & Pro Edition

  • Front-end Booking Engine Free Demo + Pro Add-ons
  • Back-end Booking Engine Free Demo
  • Back-end Booking Engine Pro Demo + Add-ons
  • Free Plugin Video Demo – Youtube link

Host Domination Booking Engine Free includes:

  • 🏠 Unlimited Properties / Rooms
  • 🖼️ Room & Property Cards: cover images, galleries, amenities and visual property
  • 🔄 No Overbooking! Free & Automatic Two-way iCal Sync (Import & Export)
  • 📅 Booking.com, Airbnb, Vrbo, Google Calendar, Holidu, Agoda, etc.
  • 🏦 Bank transfer payments per property (admin approval + manual paid confirmation)
  • 📩 Direct Booking by WhatsApp & Email
  • 🪪 Guest Self Check-in per property for Tourist Tax (Optional)
  • 💸 No Booking Commissions
  • 🤖 AI Concierge (FREE Optional Add-on)
  • 🌐 Single-Month and Two-Month Layout
  • 🧩 Free Add-ons Available
  • 🛠️ Gutenberg Block & Elementor Widget
  • 👥 Adults & Children Selection
  • 🌙 Minimum Stay Rules
  • 💰 Price per Night
  • 📊 Booking Dashboard
  • ✉️ Guest Confirmation Emails
  • 💳 Stripe Payments (PRO)
  • 🔒 Self-hosted – No Cloud Subscription Required
  • 📱 Mobile-friendly Front-end & Back-end
  • 🎨 Works with Any WordPress Theme
  • ⚡ Fast, Lightweight & Performance-Focused Booking Experience
  • 🚀 Optimized Calendar Assets – Loaded Selectively Where Needed

Host Domination Booking Engine is a multilingual WordPress booking engine, reservation request system and iCal calendar synchronization plugin with new Whatsapp Integration, designed for vacation rentals, holiday homes, apartments, villas, bed and breakfasts, guest houses, small hotels and other accommodation businesses.

Built with speed and efficiency in mind, this lightweight booking plugin for WordPress combines a responsive booking form with selective calendar asset loading to help keep pages without booking calendars lean.

Take a look at the live demo website and see for yourself what you can build and manage with Host Domination Booking Engine, including the option to show or hide prices in the calendar.

Pro Edition

  • Pro + Add-ons Plugin Video Demo – Youtube link

Host Domination Booking Engine PRO Exclusive Features:

  • 💳 Stripe Payments & Automatic Booking Confirmation
  • 🏦 Multi-Stripe Accounts per Property Manager (BETA)
  • 🏢 Ideal for Property Managers, Co-Hosts & Agencies
  • 👥 User Roles & Permissions (BETA)
  • 💰 Advanced Pricing (Daily & Monthly Rates)
  • 📅 Advanced Availability Management
  • 🗓️ Planning View (Multi-Property Timeline)
  • 🔄 Up to 10 iCal Feeds per Property
  • 📤 All-in-One iCal Export link
  • 🔗 Stripe Payment Links
  • ↩️ Stripe Refund Management
  • 📱 Mobile Web App (PWA)
  • 🔔 Push Notifications
  • 🧾 PDF Booking Receipts
  • 🧩 Premium Add-ons Available
  • 🎫 Dedicated PRO Support

🤖 NEW! AI Concierge, FREE Virtual Assistant Add-on

  • 🤖 FREE optional add-on – Add an AI concierge to your Booking Engine.
  • 🌍 Multilingual, 24/7 guest support – Automatically replies in your guests’ language.
  • 💬 Floating chat widget – Answers guest questions directly on your website.
  • 🏡 Personalized property information – Uses your FAQs, check-in details, house rules, parking and services.
  • 📅 Booking assistance – Helps guests check availability and find your booking page or WhatsApp.
  • ⚙️ Easy WordPress setup – Customize the assistant’s information and settings.
  • 🌐 Translatable interface – Compatible with the free HD BE Translate add-on.

New Free Welcome Book

  • Free Host Domination Welcome Book WordPress Plugin
  • Front-end Host Domination Welcome Book Demo + Add-ons
  • Back-end Host Domination Welcome Book Demo + Add-ons

Extra

  • NEW! Free Multilingual Pack
  • NEW! Free Advanced Report
  • NEW! Back-end Mobile Layout
  • Add-ons Store
  • New Shared Rooms & Flexible Guest Capacity Add-on for Hostel and dormitories
  • Ticket Support for Free & Pro version

The plugin is open source, self-hosted and compatible with any WordPress theme. It works directly inside your WordPress website without requiring a mandatory Host Domination cloud account or a subscription to a proprietary booking platform. The Free version does not expire.

Hosts and property managers can display an availability calendar, receive direct booking requests, review guest details in WordPress and synchronize unavailable dates through standard iCal and ICS calendar feeds.

Each calendar can also enable an optional WhatsApp request channel. Email delivery remains active and mandatory; after the request is saved and emailed, WhatsApp opens with the submitted booking details already filled in for the guest to review and send.

Both FREE and PRO support unlimited property and room calendars, with no booking commissions charged by Host Domination. Third-party payment processors or OTA platforms may charge their own fees. The website iCal export feed is available immediately and reflects confirmed direct reservations. External calendars are checked automatically approximately every 30 minutes, with an optional Refresh Calendars button. Updates on other OTAs depend on their own calendar synchronization schedules.

Host Domination Booking Engine can be used alongside Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo and other OTA or reservation platforms that provide a compatible iCal or ICS URL. You can continue using the booking channels you already work with while adding a direct booking form to your own website.

Fast, lightweight & performance-focused WordPress booking engine

A fast and lightweight booking engine should load only the resources it needs. Host Domination Booking Engine is designed around efficient asset loading, a streamlined interface and responsive calendars for desktop and mobile visitors.

  • Selective JavaScript loading: Calendar-related scripts, including Flatpickr, its Italian locale and the global calendar selector, are requested only where booking calendars are rendered.
  • Reduced unnecessary requests: Pages without booking calendars avoid these calendar-specific JavaScript resources, helping reduce avoidable front-end overhead.
  • Optimized calendar styles: Flatpickr CSS is loaded selectively while preserving calendar presentation where it is needed.
  • Page-builder support: The calendar asset strategy is designed to support shortcodes, native Gutenberg blocks, Elementor widgets and live editor previews.
  • Efficient, mobile-friendly experience: A responsive availability calendar and booking request form help guests browse dates and send requests without unnecessary steps.

These improvements target unnecessary asset loading; actual page speed also depends on your WordPress theme, other plugins, hosting, caching and the content of each page.

Direct booking requests from your WordPress website

Turn your WordPress website into an additional direct booking channel.

Guests can select and submit:

  • Check-in and check-out dates
  • Number of adults
  • Number of children up to the maximum age configured for the selected calendar
  • Full name
  • Email address
  • Contact phone number
  • Additional notes
  • Mandatory Privacy Policy consent before submission
  • Optional acceptance of linked Terms and Conditions when configured by the website administrator
  • Optional WhatsApp opening with a prefilled copy of the submitted request

New requests appear in the WordPress administration area. Administrators can review, confirm, reject or delete them.

Pending requests do not become confirmed reservations automatically. Once a request is confirmed, its dates are included in the internal availability calendar and in the website iCal export feed.

Native Gutenberg Block & Elementor Widget – Add a single booking calendar or the multi-calendar booking form directly from Gutenberg or Elementor, without manually entering shortcodes. Shortcodes remain available for other WordPress page builders.

Each calendar generates its own shortcode. For example:

[hdbe_booking_calendar id=”123″]

Replace 123 with the ID shown in the Created Properties / Rooms table after saving your calendar.

Front-end availability calendar

Display a responsive booking calendar that allows guests to select arrival and departure dates directly from your website.

The calendar shows:

  • Available dates
  • Unavailable dates
  • Confirmed website reservations
  • Reservations imported from external iCal feeds
  • Selectable check-in and check-out boundaries
  • The minimum stay required
  • An optional base price per night

Built for hosts and property managers

Host Domination Booking Engine can be used by:

  • Individual hosts
  • Vacation rental owners
  • Airbnb hosts
  • Property managers
  • Bed and breakfast owners
  • Apartment managers
  • Villa rental businesses
  • Small hotels
  • Guest houses
  • Short-term rental agencies
  • WordPress developers
  • Web agencies creating accommodation websites

Calendar and accommodation settings

Create a calendar for your room, apartment or accommodation and configure:

  • Calendar or accommodation name
  • Maximum number of guests
  • Minimum number of nights
  • Optional base price per night
  • EUR or USD currency
  • Whether the nightly price is displayed in the public calendar
  • External iCal or ICS calendar links
  • Required Privacy Policy URL for GDPR and personal-data information
  • Optional Terms and Conditions URL covering booking, cancellation, refund and reservation rules
  • Receive requests channels, with mandatory Email and optional WhatsApp per calendar
  • International WhatsApp destination number when the optional channel is enabled
  • Website iCal export URL

The Free version supports unlimited accommodation calendars.

Host Domination Booking Engine PRO adds online payments, advanced pricing, premium add-ons and extended external iCal capacity; both editions support unlimited accommodation calendars.

Minimum stay validation

Set the minimum number of nights required for the accommodation.

If a guest selects a shorter stay, the booking form displays a validation message and prevents the request from being submitted until a valid date range is selected.

Optional nightly price display

The Free version allows you to configure a base price per night and display it on available dates in the public calendar.

Host Domination Booking Engine PRO adds advanced pricing tools for day, month and yearly pricing rules, including different prices for selected dates and periods.

iCal and ICS calendar synchronization

Host Domination Booking Engine supports standard iCal and ICS calendar feeds.

You can:

  • Import unavailable dates from an external calendar
  • Import reservations from a compatible OTA calendar
  • Automatically check connected external iCal calendars approximately every 30 minutes
  • Run an immediate manual import through Refresh Calendars
  • Generate an instantly available website iCal export URL
  • Export confirmed direct website reservations immediately through the live feed
  • Keep imported OTA reservations unavailable on your website calendar
  • Connect the website calendar to other compatible reservation systems

Compatible sources may include:

  • Airbnb
  • Booking.com
  • Vrbo
  • Google Calendar
  • Apple Calendar
  • Tripadvisor
  • Other vacation rental platforms
  • Property management systems that provide an iCal or ICS URL
  • Agoda or Expedia-connected properties when the platform, account or connected property management system provides a compatible iCal feed

Compatibility depends on the availability and format of the calendar feed supplied by each external service.

Automatic calendar synchronization in the Free version

The Free version supports:

  • Unlimited property and room calendars
  • Instant website iCal export of confirmed direct reservations
  • An immediate import attempt when an external iCal URL is saved
  • Automatic import checks approximately every 30 minutes through WordPress scheduled tasks
  • Manual import at any time through the Refresh Calendars button
  • A dedicated website iCal export URL for each property or room calendar

The iCal export feed updates immediately when a direct reservation is confirmed. External OTAs determine when they synchronize and read that feed, so updates may appear later on those platforms. The plugin automatically checks incoming feeds approximately every 30 minutes; this interval can vary with WordPress cron, website traffic and hosting configuration. Click Refresh Calendars to check external feeds on demand. Two-way iCal synchronization helps reduce overbooking risk, but is not a real-time guarantee.

Two-way iCal calendar workflow

A typical synchronization workflow is:

  1. Export the iCal or ICS URL from Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo or another compatible platform.
  2. Paste the external URL into Host Domination Booking Engine.
  3. Save the calendar. The plugin performs the initial import immediately.
  4. Copy the Website iCal Feed URL generated by the plugin.
  5. Import the generated URL into the external booking platform.
  6. Confirm direct booking requests received from your website so that their dates are included in the exported feed.
  7. The Free plugin checks connected iCal feeds approximately every 30 minutes. You can also use Refresh Calendars at any time to run an immediate manual import.

The plugin imports and exports availability through standard calendar feeds. It does not use the private APIs of the listed booking platforms.

Reduce the risk of double bookings

Calendar synchronization helps keep availability consistent between your WordPress website and compatible external booking channels.

Imported reservations are displayed as unavailable dates in the booking calendar. Confirmed direct reservations are included in the website iCal feed and can be imported by compatible OTA platforms.

Responsive and mobile-friendly booking form

The front-end booking calendar is designed for desktop computers, tablets and smartphones.

Interested in Host Domination Booking Engine PRO?

Curious about the PRO version?

Take a look at the live demo website and see for yourself what you can build and manage with Host Domination Booking Engine PRO.

  • Front-end Demo Website

Host Domination Booking Engine PRO

Host Domination Booking Engine PRO extends the booking system with online payments, multiple calendar sources, flexible prices, advanced availability controls and premium add-ons.

PRO features include:

  • Unlimited accommodation, room or property calendars
  • Multiple-room or property selector on the front end
  • Expanded external iCal / ICS source connections for each property or room
  • Unified iCal calendar generation
  • iCal calendar merger and calendar unifier
  • Advanced day, month and yearly pricing
  • Different prices for specific dates and periods
  • Advanced date availability controls
  • Blocking of selected dates or entire months
  • Stripe online payments
  • Payment status management
  • Expanded reservation management

Host Domination Bookign Engine is NOT a channel manager/PMS.

Fast & Lightweight WordPress Booking Engine for Unlimited Properties & Rooms – A streamlined, performance-focused booking tool for hosts who want a fast, efficient reservation experience without unnecessary assets on pages that do not display a booking calendar.

Host Domination Booking Engine is a multilingual WordPress booking engine, reservation request system and iCal calendar synchronization plugin with new Whatsapp Integration, designed for vacation rentals, holiday homes, apartments, villas, bed and breakfasts, guest houses, small hotels and other accommodation businesses.

Built with speed and efficiency in mind, this lightweight booking plugin for WordPress combines a responsive booking form with selective calendar asset loading to help keep pages without booking calendars lean.

Take a look at the live demo website and see for yourself what you can build and manage with Host Domination Booking Engine, including the option to show or hide prices in the calendar.

  • 💳 Stripe Payments & Automatic Booking Confirmation
  • 🏦 Multi-Stripe Accounts per Property Manager (BETA)

The plugin is open source, self-hosted and compatible with any WordPress theme. It works directly inside your WordPress website without requiring a mandatory Host Domination cloud account or a subscription to a proprietary booking platform. The Free version does not expire.

Hosts and property managers can display an availability calendar, receive direct booking requests, review guest details in WordPress and synchronize unavailable dates through standard iCal and ICS calendar feeds.

Each calendar can also enable an optional WhatsApp request channel. Email delivery remains active and mandatory; after the request is saved and emailed, WhatsApp opens with the submitted booking details already filled in for the guest to review and send.

Both FREE and PRO support unlimited property and room calendars, with no booking commissions charged by Host Domination. Third-party payment processors or OTA platforms may charge their own fees. The website iCal export feed is available immediately and reflects confirmed direct reservations. External calendars are checked automatically approximately every 30 minutes, with an optional Refresh Calendars button. Updates on other OTAs depend on their own calendar synchronization schedules.

Host Domination Booking Engine can be used alongside Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo and other OTA or reservation platforms that provide a compatible iCal or ICS URL. You can continue using the booking channels you already work with while adding a direct booking form to your own website.

Fast, lightweight & performance-focused WordPress booking engine

A fast and lightweight booking engine should load only the resources it needs. Host Domination Booking Engine is designed around efficient asset loading, a streamlined interface and responsive calendars for desktop and mobile visitors.

  • Selective JavaScript loading: Calendar-related scripts, including Flatpickr, its Italian locale and the global calendar selector, are requested only where booking calendars are rendered.
  • Reduced unnecessary requests: Pages without booking calendars avoid these calendar-specific JavaScript resources, helping reduce avoidable front-end overhead.
  • Optimized calendar styles: Flatpickr CSS is loaded selectively while preserving calendar presentation where it is needed.
  • Page-builder support: The calendar asset strategy is designed to support shortcodes, native Gutenberg blocks, Elementor widgets and live editor previews.
  • Efficient, mobile-friendly experience: A responsive availability calendar and booking request form help guests browse dates and send requests without unnecessary steps.

These improvements target unnecessary asset loading; actual page speed also depends on your WordPress theme, other plugins, hosting, caching and the content of each page.

Direct booking requests from your WordPress website

Turn your WordPress website into an additional direct booking channel.

Guests can select and submit:

  • Check-in and check-out dates
  • Number of adults
  • Number of children up to the maximum age configured for the selected calendar
  • Full name
  • Email address
  • Contact phone number
  • Additional notes
  • Mandatory Privacy Policy consent before submission
  • Optional acceptance of linked Terms and Conditions when configured by the website administrator
  • Optional WhatsApp opening with a prefilled copy of the submitted request

New requests appear in the WordPress administration area. Administrators can review, confirm, reject or delete them.

Pending requests do not become confirmed reservations automatically. Once a request is confirmed, its dates are included in the internal availability calendar and in the website iCal export feed.

Native Gutenberg Block & Elementor Widget – Add a single booking calendar or the multi-calendar booking form directly from Gutenberg or Elementor, without manually entering shortcodes. Shortcodes remain available for other WordPress page builders.

Each calendar generates its own shortcode. For example:

[hdbe_booking_calendar id=”123″]

Replace 123 with the ID shown in the Created Properties / Rooms table after saving your calendar.

Front-end availability calendar

Display a responsive booking calendar that allows guests to select arrival and departure dates directly from your website.

The calendar shows:

  • Available dates
  • Unavailable dates
  • Confirmed website reservations
  • Reservations imported from external iCal feeds
  • Selectable check-in and check-out boundaries
  • The minimum stay required
  • An optional base price per night

Built for hosts and property managers

Host Domination Booking Engine can be used by:

  • Individual hosts
  • Vacation rental owners
  • Airbnb hosts
  • Property managers
  • Bed and breakfast owners
  • Apartment managers
  • Villa rental businesses
  • Small hotels
  • Guest houses
  • Short-term rental agencies
  • WordPress developers
  • Web agencies creating accommodation websites

Calendar and accommodation settings

Create a calendar for your room, apartment or accommodation and configure:

  • Calendar or accommodation name
  • Maximum number of guests
  • Minimum number of nights
  • Optional base price per night
  • EUR or USD currency
  • Whether the nightly price is displayed in the public calendar
  • External iCal or ICS calendar links
  • Required Privacy Policy URL for GDPR and personal-data information
  • Optional Terms and Conditions URL covering booking, cancellation, refund and reservation rules
  • Receive requests channels, with mandatory Email and optional WhatsApp per calendar
  • International WhatsApp destination number when the optional channel is enabled
  • Website iCal export URL

The Free version supports unlimited accommodation calendars.

Host Domination Booking Engine PRO adds online payments, advanced pricing, premium add-ons and extended external iCal capacity; both editions support unlimited accommodation calendars.

Minimum stay validation

Set the minimum number of nights required for the accommodation.

If a guest selects a shorter stay, the booking form displays a validation message and prevents the request from being submitted until a valid date range is selected.

Optional nightly price display

The Free version allows you to configure a base price per night and display it on available dates in the public calendar.

Host Domination Booking Engine PRO adds advanced pricing tools for day, month and yearly pricing rules, including different prices for selected dates and periods.

iCal and ICS calendar synchronization

Host Domination Booking Engine supports standard iCal and ICS calendar feeds.

You can:

  • Import unavailable dates from an external calendar
  • Import reservations from a compatible OTA calendar
  • Automatically check connected external iCal calendars approximately every 30 minutes
  • Run an immediate manual import through Refresh Calendars
  • Generate an instantly available website iCal export URL
  • Export confirmed direct website reservations immediately through the live feed
  • Keep imported OTA reservations unavailable on your website calendar
  • Connect the website calendar to other compatible reservation systems

Compatible sources may include:

  • Airbnb
  • Booking.com
  • Vrbo
  • Google Calendar
  • Apple Calendar
  • Tripadvisor
  • Other vacation rental platforms
  • Property management systems that provide an iCal or ICS URL
  • Agoda or Expedia-connected properties when the platform, account or connected property management system provides a compatible iCal feed

Compatibility depends on the availability and format of the calendar feed supplied by each external service.

Automatic calendar synchronization in the Free version

The Free version supports:

  • Unlimited property and room calendars
  • Instant website iCal export of confirmed direct reservations
  • An immediate import attempt when an external iCal URL is saved
  • Automatic import checks approximately every 30 minutes through WordPress scheduled tasks
  • Manual import at any time through the Refresh Calendars button
  • A dedicated website iCal export URL for each property or room calendar

The iCal export feed updates immediately when a direct reservation is confirmed. External OTAs determine when they synchronize and read that feed, so updates may appear later on those platforms. The plugin automatically checks incoming feeds approximately every 30 minutes; this interval can vary with WordPress cron, website traffic and hosting configuration. Click Refresh Calendars to check external feeds on demand. Two-way iCal synchronization helps reduce overbooking risk, but is not a real-time guarantee.

Two-way iCal calendar workflow

A typical synchronization workflow is:

  1. Export the iCal or ICS URL from Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo or another compatible platform.
  2. Paste the external URL into Host Domination Booking Engine.
  3. Save the calendar. The plugin performs the initial import immediately.
  4. Copy the Website iCal Feed URL generated by the plugin.
  5. Import the generated URL into the external booking platform.
  6. Confirm direct booking requests received from your website so that their dates are included in the exported feed.
  7. The Free plugin checks connected iCal feeds approximately every 30 minutes. You can also use Refresh Calendars at any time to run an immediate manual import.

The plugin imports and exports availability through standard calendar feeds. It does not use the private APIs of the listed booking platforms.

Reduce the risk of double bookings

Calendar synchronization helps keep availability consistent between your WordPress website and compatible external booking channels.

Imported reservations are displayed as unavailable dates in the booking calendar. Confirmed direct reservations are included in the website iCal feed and can be imported by compatible OTA platforms.

Responsive and mobile-friendly booking form

The front-end booking calendar is designed for desktop computers, tablets and smartphones.

Interested in Host Domination Booking Engine PRO?

Curious about the PRO version?

Take a look at the live demo website and see for yourself what you can build and manage with Host Domination Booking Engine PRO.

  • Front-end Demo Website

Host Domination Booking Engine PRO

Host Domination Booking Engine PRO extends the booking system with online payments, multiple calendar sources, flexible prices, advanced availability controls and premium add-ons.

PRO features include:

  • Unlimited accommodation, room or property calendars
  • Multiple-room or property selector on the front end
  • Expanded external iCal / ICS source connections for each property or room
  • Unified iCal calendar generation
  • iCal calendar merger and calendar unifier
  • Advanced day, month and yearly pricing
  • Different prices for specific dates and periods
  • Advanced date availability controls
  • Blocking of selected dates or entire months
  • Stripe online payments
  • Payment status management
  • Expanded reservation management

Host Domination Bookign Engine is NOT a channel manager/PMS.
